anticipo-serie-ayuda: Advance payment invoices are issued in this series, with their own numbering.
anticipo-importe-o-porcentaje: Enter the amount or the percentage of the document total.
anticipo-registrado: Advance payment registered: invoice %codigo% for %total%, already collected.
anticipo-importe-invalido: Enter an amount or a percentage greater than zero for a document with an amount.
anticipo-supera-total: Advance payments would exceed the document total (%total%).
anticipo-importe-ajustado: The advance payment was invoiced for %total% instead of %pedido% because of VAT rounding.
anticipo-excede: The advance payment on invoice %codigo% (%anticipo%) exceeds what is left to invoice (%resto%): it was not deducted. Refund it by issuing a credit note for the advance payment invoice.
anticipos-aplicados: %num% advance payments deducted. Remaining to collect: %resto%.
anticipos-sin-aplicar: There are %num% advance payments not yet applied, totalling %total%.
anticipo-rectificativa-parcial: The credit note for %codigo% does not cancel the whole advance payment: it stays pending, check its amount.
anticipo-aplicado-rectificado: Advance payment %codigo% is already deducted in invoice %final%: also issue a credit note for the final invoice.
anticipo-devuelto-auto: Advance payment %codigo% is now marked as refunded and will not be deducted.
anticipo-borrar-aplicado: It cannot be deleted: this invoice is an advance payment already deducted in another invoice.
modulo-no-activo: The Advance payments module is not active in your plan.
